name: Zibo
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official bureau report says an entry is available on the bureau website and WeChat; map browse/locate, registration-information query and cadastral/house-plan downloads are described as available to anyone. No direct live viewer/API URL was located.
technicalBlocker: The bureau documents a public-facing “以图查房” map search, but its report does not expose a direct live viewer URL or service endpoint. The official /land/index.html link is a separate secondary-market transaction platform, not the registry/map viewer. No anonymous cadastral polygon response was obtained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the map UI remains operational, whether map browsing returns full parcel polygons or only on-demand map sheets, and whether viewing/download requires authentication. Current direct viewer entry is unknown.
nextStep: Find the current “以图查房” entry from the bureau site/official WeChat and inspect its public HTML/JS; test a small anonymous geometry-only query only if it exposes vector features.

executedQueries.query: 淄博市 自然资源和规划局 地籍图 宗地 不动产登记 查询 GIS 官方
executedQueries.result: 官方2023年度公开报告记载，网站和微信公众号开通“以图查房”入口，可地图定位/按房屋坐落查询不动产自然属性与限制信息、查看和下载宗地图及房屋分户图；报告未给出直达入口。跟进局网站首页发现的 HTTPS /land/index.html 是“淄博市土地二级市场交易服务平台”，并非不动产地籍图查询入口；该页仅载入底图脚本，没有可确认的地籍图矢量查询接口。官方权籍调查规范要求宗地图矢量 SHAPE 作为测绘成果提交，未声明公开下载。
executedQueries.method: Separate Simplified Chinese search; official city bureau report/procedure pages opened, no viewer link/service route exposed by results.

officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 official bureau page; lines 617–623 state map-based query and downloadable plot/house plans, available to anyone, but omit direct entry URL.
Official city survey procedure says cadastral vector outputs are SHAPE survey products with application/purpose conditions; this is not an open data service.
Official city cadastral-survey rules describe parcel survey datasets and registered-record access; no anonymous bulk geometry service is identified.

officialSources.method: Direct anonymous HTTPS GET with browser-like headers; official bureau homepage link followed
officialSources.observation: Page title identifies the Zibo Land Secondary Market Trading Service Platform, not the reported “以图查房” registry viewer. The page embeds a Tianditu base-map script with a public token in the HTML; token value was not recorded or reused. No cadastral feature endpoint was verified.
